## Environment model generated by timed relational abstraction
## 
## Initial state abstracted via predicates
ASSUME ({(x)<1} && {(y)<1})
## Transition (for others, then there is no explicit control)
ASSUME ALWAYS (({(x)<1} && !g1) -> NEXT ({(x)<1}))
ASSUME ALWAYS (({(x)<1} && g1) -> NEXT ({(x)<1} || {(x)<2}))

ASSUME ALWAYS (({(y)<1} && !g2) -> NEXT ({(y)<1}))
ASSUME ALWAYS (({(y)<1} && g2) -> NEXT ({(y)<1} || {(y)<2}))

## Specification to be fulfilled: control the system to ensure that it stays within the ball
EVENTUALLY ALWAYS ({(x*x)+(y*y)<7})

INPUT  x([0;4]), y([0;4])
OUTPUT g1, g2
